item.title: How to use Bitbucket Pipelines with Git
item.description: Bitbucket Pipelines provides integrated CI/CD directly in Bitbucket repositories, automating builds, tests, and deployments triggered by Git operations. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve implemented Bitbucket Pipelines in enterprise projects. The most straightforward approach is creating a bitbucket-pipelines.yml file in the repository root defining pipeline configuration. This method enables automatic testing and deployment on every Git push with Docker-based build environments.
